0022600175.text: The Bucks (1-6) come into this eighth game of the season on a three-game losing streak, with a 0-3 road record and a 14th-place standing in the East, five games behind in the Central. The Celtics (5-2) are 4-0 at home, sit second in the Atlantic and third in the East, and have lost their most recent game. Kam Jones (ankle, day-to-day) is a game-time decision for Milwaukee, while Boston will be without Devin Carter (illness) and Jayson Tatum (rest), with Payton Pritchard (shoulder, day-to-day) also a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Milwaukee lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 133-101 defeat at home on April 3, 2026.
